blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Police are hunting a 26-year-old suspect who allegedly shot dead a man and wounded another during a confrontation in Amadeo, Cavite early Saturday, Nov. 14. At around 2 a.m., for still unknown reasons, the suspect allegedly trespassed into a compound in Barangay Tamacan, where the victims lived, according to the Calabarzon police.
